Hi Alicia — really helpful doc, thanks. High-level confirmation below and a short mutual action plan so we have clear owners for Day-0.

Summary answers:
- Outbound egress: Redwood will originate requests from the edge instances; required outbound CIDRs are listed in the attached redwood-edge-activation-checklist.pdf (page 2). Primary ports are 443 (TLS) plus 12345 (internal telemetry) — we’ll fall back to region-level endpoints if cross-zone peering fails.
- Cross-zone routing: Cross-AZ routing is supported but we require that Mediq enable TCP path MTU discovery and allow ephemeral outbound ports (49152-65535) to preserve long-lived KV streams. We’ve noted this in the checklist that we’ll send to your security team.

Mutual action items (owner / due):
1) Redwood: provide signed activation checklist + egress CIDR table — Priya (due 2028-02-09).
2) Mediq: confirm firewall updates & provide change window ticket id — Alicia / ops-eng (due 2028-02-11).
3) Redwood: pre-provision bastion access + test SSH jump (if needed) — Ben (due 2028-02-13).
4) Both: smoke test plan for Day-0 — joint doc in Drive (link below).

I’ve attached the checklist PDF for your security/compliance team to review. If you’d like, we can get this routed through DocuSign and include the minimal SLAs for egress handling.

Cheers,
Priya

Quick technical notes from infra:
- CIDR specifics: expect outbound NAT from 52.33.120.0/22 and 34.21.200.0/23 for the US region. We included a small, static subset in the PDF to reduce firewall footprint.
- Ports: 443 (TLS) for model pulls and 9001 for model-serving control-plane (health checks). Telemetry backfill will use ephemeral ports as Priya noted.
- Bastion: we will create a time-limited bastion keypair and add your SRE users. Process: create a support ticket referencing the change window, attach SSH public keys to ticket.

Sample firewall rule (for your ops):
ALLOW TCP 52.33.120.0/22 -> * : 443
ALLOW TCP 34.21.200.0/23 -> * : 9001
ALLOW TCP <your-internal-ips> -> 52.33.120.0/22 : 49152-65535 (established KV streams)

I’ll run a quick preflight from our staging edge tonight and post the results to the Drive doc.

- Ben
Ben Carter
